agent.name: Special Dark Organizational Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: SubAgent 6 - organizational readiness and implementation conditions

analytical_question: Is this organization ready for a four-week isolated public/synthetic chart-review learning exercise, and what would separately be required to sustain routine use? Identify one binding factor, proportionate actions and decision-critical missing evidence.
general_et_finding: Organizational readiness is a socio-technical capacity judgment, not a technology-maturity classification. Leadership, skills, process, data/infrastructure, resources, governance, affected users and operating ownership must support the requested scope. Weak organizational preparation cannot make the technology less mature, and prepared staff cannot prove model reliability. S1/S2 inform voluntary governance/evaluation practices, not a certified readiness score.
application_finding: Human-supervised read-only chart/source review is a plausible application for investigation, but representative technical accuracy and incremental value over adequate manual/deterministic checks remain unproved. The same unresolved application evidence applies to every organizational chart profile. A training or workflow rehearsal does not establish task performance. No autonomous publication or consequential financial/customer decision is in scope.
organization_specific_finding:
CONDITIONALLY_READY_FOR_ISOLATED_LEARNING for the requested isolated-learning scope. Planning may continue without agent execution. ROUTINE_READINESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED: independent task/value qualification and operating release are absent.
Most consequential factor: residual task/workflow evidence. No known critical organizational blocker is stipulated for the isolated trial. The binding remaining limit is the narrow permission and unmeasured task/workflow outcomes: readiness is conditional on keeping the supplied arrangements, not a new deployment approval.
Eight-domain evidence:
leadership_sponsorship: SUPPORTED — Reporting sponsor accepted a scoped four-week charter and risk decision rights for isolated learning.
skills_training: SUPPORTED — BI review lead and deputy completed source/error/escalation practice with mixed-experience analysts; task performance is not yet validated.
workflow_process: SUPPORTED — Reporting process owner rehearsed source-linked review, exception queue, human acceptance and manual fallback.
infrastructure_data: SUPPORTED — Security/data authority stipulated approval for an isolated public/synthetic read-only model/tool route, source lineage and logs; no internal-data or publication permission.
resources_budget: SUPPORTED — Finance owner covers a 24-hour total four-week cap; reporting manager protects the 9-hour task/review allocation plus assigned setup/drill/debrief time. A separate next-quarter support allocation with amount, period, approver and contingency record is stipulated approved, conditional on a later operating release; it does not supply task qualification or release.
governance_risk: SUPPORTED — Model-risk officer accepted scoped stop/escalation/change authority and a restoration drill.
culture_change: SUPPORTED — Affected reviewers were consulted about workload and have a nonpunitive feedback/dissent route; sustained acceptance remains unmeasured.
operating_ownership: SUPPORTED — Named fictional service-owner role and deputy accepted learning duty, review cover, incident/maintenance/retirement tasks and protected time.
Strengths: recognize the supplied BI source/analyst foundation and every supported case-specific arrangement; these are fictional premises, not measured effectiveness. No readiness percentage is computed.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: All current organizational profiles and permissions/resources are fictional diagnostic premises, not real company observations or approval.
These current saved examples are authored and reviewed by the same assistant; they are not independent model trials, measured reliability or a completed chart pilot.
No profile supplies demonstrated comparative value or routine operating release. Unknown is not a proven lack or a passed check.
Do not import member-specific university facts, historical market statistics, vendor terms or legal conclusions into the financial chart case.
Dissent: unnecessary production-level prerequisites can delay useful learning; scope gates to the actual activity without waiving permission, competent review or accountable stop/cover.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Clear conditional logic under the supplied premises; limited external validity. No independent model-performance estimate, readiness probability, compliance finding or validated predictive score is claimed.
value_opportunity_implication: Organizational preparation may make a bounded investigation feasible, not beneficial by itself. Compare complete manual/deterministic/agent-assisted effort and error consequences before asserting incremental value.
risk_governance_implication: Honor the exact stage, route and data permission; retain human publication authority, accepted competent review/cover, stop/escalation/restore and reassessment. A team-approved analytical agent is not actual company trial or release authority.
recommendation_management_implication: CONDITIONALLY_READY_FOR_ISOLATED_LEARNING — Do not re-establish the sponsor, owner, trained cover, route or rehearsal already supported in the case. Maintain the accepted scope/cover/cap and execute only after real human authorization if applied outside this teaching case. P1: supplied BI review lead/service owner records full task and workflow results with predefined criteria; closure is source-linked outcomes, complete effort and stop/absence drill evidence. P2: sponsor/service owner returns that evidence to Adoption and authorized humans before any broader release. The proposed24h four-week design allocates4+5+9+4+2 hours; stipulated40 tasks ×12 complete minutes =8 review hours within9 allocated, leaving1 planning hour. These are fictional planning inputs, not observed speed or safe sample proof.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess on actual scope-specific authority/denial, owner/deputy change, protected capacity or funding change.
Review ordinary-user feedback, actual full effort, incidents, source/model/tool/term changes and workflow restoration evidence.
Before broader operation require separate task/value qualification, sustainable resources and authorized human release; no automatic escalation from a small PoC.
Proposed two-week evidence review if blocked; four-week learning debrief if genuinely authorized. Neither is a statutory deadline.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: OBSERVE_IN_AUTHORIZED_LEARNING: BI review lead/service owner—record actual full handling times, material misses/false corrections, source lineage, ordinary-reviewer feedback and absence/restore performance; reduce or stop if cap/cover fails.
ASK_NOW before any routine release: sponsor—provide independent task/value qualification and actual release authority; a recurring resource allocation is not release approval.
